_note: Loop 1 crossings (placeholder, Tim to tune). Drawing only: walking is decided by world.json fords + rules.fordRadius. Kept out of world_paint.json because the atlas registration hashes that file. Merged into the paint settings in src/main.js.

fordBed._note: Gravel bar painted into the river bed at each of the 8 fords (units). along/across = half-size of the bar along/across the river; solid = share kept fully gravel before the ragged edge fades; waterLevel = water mask over the bar (0.455 hides water, 0.545 full water); shallow = strength of the clear shallow-water look.

bridge._note: Plain plank strip across the river at each of the 9 bridges (units). overhang = extra length past each edge of the painted water.
